title: transport
summary: MSUI consumes the server path-progress anchor for both transport families. Type-11 lifts sample spawn-quaternion-rotated TransportAnimation keyframes. Type-15 vessels consume template data0..2, build TaxiPathNode Catmull-Rom timetables, self-pin to the exact build-5875 client period, sample (anchor + elapsed) modulo that period, drive dynamic position/facing, dwell at stops, and hide while their cycle is on another map. WMO-display vessels publish owner-keyed hull instances through WmoRenderer and their set-0 MODD sails/rotors/furniture through DoodadRenderer; both move in place and share host-GUID picking/lifecycle. Observed riders compose their retained transport-local pose through either armed transport matrix. Controlled riders consume owner-aware live collision from WMO vessel hulls or M2 lift cars, rigid carry, transport-local movement tails, and vessel worldport continuity under systems/player. Fresh creates and movement-only re-anchors remain distinct.

openItems.text: Type-15 MO_TRANSPORT boats/zeppelins never move: no TaxiPathNode.dbc timetable build from the template's (taxiPathId, moveSpeed, accelRate) tuple, no (anchor + elapsed) % period sampling - a streamed boat renders frozen at its create pose (if rendered at all).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: TaxiPathNodeCatalog and MoTransportTimetable consume template data0..2, perform the vanilla/vmangos skip dance and 20-chord Catmull-Rom sampling, and pin the clock to the exact client period. Runtime samples (anchor + elapsed) modulo that period before GameObject rendering and supplies a path-derived facing override. All nine live build-5875 periods match exactly in the focused real-data check.

openItems.text: Type-11 TRANSPORT elevators/lifts never move: no TransportAnimation.dbc keyframe path keyed by template entry, no spawn-quat composed sampling.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: TransportAnimationCatalog loads and validates the seven-field build-5875 table by template entry. Each anchored type-11 GameObject samples (pathProgress + local elapsed) modulo the last-keyframe period, linearly interpolates the bracketing local offsets, rotates by GAMEOBJECT_ROTATION (wire yaw fallback), and writes the world pose before dynamic GameObject rendering. Re-create identity resets the stationary spawn frame; movement-only re-anchors do not. Doodad instances and cull/pick bounds move in place. Armed cars additionally expose their retained M2 collision hull at the live transform, stay out of the static BVH, and feed controlled-rider support/carry. Focused checks cover dwell, interpolation, wrap, spawn rotation, real Mesa 4170/4171 and Undercity 152614 rows; full interface-wire and solution builds pass.

openItems.text: Observed riders are not carried: the on-transport local pose from create blocks and MSG_MOVE_* relays now reaches WorldEntity, but it is not yet composed through a live transport matrix, so a deck NPC or fellow passenger still renders at the packet's fallback world pose.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Observed unit TransportPose values are composed every frame through an armed type-11 or type-15 transport position/yaw. The controlled player is intentionally excluded from this observed-presentation slice and remains separately tracked.

openItems.text: Type-15 transports still have no dock/depart timetable behavior or off-map hiding while sailing another continent's leg. Type-11 lift dwell/motion spans now come directly from TransportAnimation keyframes.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Type-15 timetable windows expose authored dwell/motion state and current map. The renderer removes the vessel's local placement for every sample on a different map, preventing a stale dock hull; type-11 dwell/motion continues to come from TransportAnimation keyframes.

openItems.text: Focused ElevatorTransport and ControlledTransport checks, the full interface-wire suite, and the client build pass. Live-verify both Thunder Bluff Mesa cars and Undercity elevators: server-clock synchronization, dwell/depart/arrival timing, full vertical travel, correct rotated spawn frame, re-create/re-anchor continuity, dynamic pick and live collision hulls following the car, controlled boarding/walking/jumping/deboarding and ON_TRANSPORT tails, observed passenger carry, no ghost collider, no appear-fade restart or M2 animation reset while moving, and parked behavior for a type-11 entry with no authored path.

Focused MoTransport, ElevatorTransport, WmoGameObject and ControlledTransport checks, the full interface-wire suite, and the client build pass. Live-verify a boat and zeppelin: visible WMO hull, set-0 sails/rotor/furniture, server-clock phase, exact dock dwell/depart/arrival, path heading, map-leg hiding/reappearance, re-anchor continuity, moving hull/prop pick bounds, animation continuity, observed passenger composition, controlled deck support/carry and worldport continuity.

Stock boat and zeppelin displays are WMO hulls, while the current per-GameObject dynamic renderer is M2-oriented. The exact type-15 timetable/world pose is live, but a dynamic WMO placement/render/pick path is still required to guarantee the stock hull is visible and follows that pose.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: GameObjectDisplayInfo paths ending in .wmo publish into WmoRenderer's owner-keyed dynamic instance lane, using a direct WoW-space scale/Z-yaw/translation transform and in-place draw/cull/pick bound updates. Set-0 MODD props publish into stable host-GUID/prop-index M2 instances, follow the hull every frame, preserve independent animation/particle identity, and are excluded from static residency enumeration. Off-map, display-swap, despawn and residency-reset reconciliation remove/rebuild both lanes. The real build-5875 fixture pins display 3015 to transportship.wmo and its single 134-prop set; focused/full checks and the solution build pass.
